scientific_integrity: The proof is an all-length case classification with rational generating functions and a weak convergence argument; independent review has not been performed. Finite reproducibility checks do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only binary words containing exactly two ones; occurrence intervals, not distinct maximizing factor values. The length marginal was already implied by the known weight-two longest-border spectrum. The new claim is exact multiplicity enumeration and its joint sparse-source law; no unrestricted-input or faster-algorithm theorem. Earlier unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: Exact multiplicities of longest unbordered factors in two-marker binary words
